_comment: Welcome email sent by the join app once a member has accepted the GitHub invitation (portal mode, share-prototype branch). Placeholders: {{name}} {{portal_url}}.
welcome_body:
Dear {{name}},

Welcome to MorphoCloud! Everything happens on your portal: {{portal_url}}

  1. Sign in with GitHub.
  2. Create your storage (MyDrive). You get 100 GB that stays when an instance is deleted; your Desktop, Documents and Downloads folders live there, and you can upload and download files from the portal at any time, with or without an instance. There is no backup.
  3. Create your instance. Choose an instance type (we advise the default, g3.large) and press Create instance. It is ready in 5 to 10 minutes; the portal shows the access details, and an email tells you when it is ready.

When you are done for the day, press Shelve; press Unshelve to start it again. A running instance shelves itself when its session runs out, and an instance shelved for more than 4 weeks is deleted; your files in MyDrive stay.

Your storage is kept for 120 days from the day you create it; the portal shows the date. From 14 days before it, the portal offers Ask to keep my storage, and a MorphoCloud admin can extend it.

Bring in data from MorphoSource. The portal's MorphoSource Media Cart downloads the datasets in your MorphoSource media cart straight into MyDrive (the MorphoSource folder), with no instance running. Connect it once with your MorphoSource API key.

MorphoCloud Chatbot. If you get stuck, ask the chatbot on your portal: it answers questions about MorphoCloud, your instance and 3D Slicer. The User Guide has step-by-step instructions, and you can always reach us at portal@morphocloud.org.

Join the community. Questions, tips and troubleshooting live in MorphoCloud Discussions: browse or post in Q&A when you need help, and watch Announcements for service updates and events.

A note about emails: MorphoCloud's own emails (your instance is ready, expiry notices, outages) come from no-reply@morphocloud.org; add it to your safe senders. We will also add your email address to the SlicerMorph mailing list, a low-volume list (2 to 3 emails a month), so you receive updates about both SlicerMorph and MorphoCloud, upcoming events and office hours; you can unsubscribe at any time. GitHub may also notify the address on your GitHub account about your request on GitHub; you can turn those off at github.com/settings/notifications without affecting MorphoCloud's emails.

Welcome aboard!
The MorphoCloud Team
